Proposition
[Product rule]

Source: petersen:page-0063 ↗ prop:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-tensor-formula

1. ch2:2.1.3For $(0,k_i)$-tensors, \[ L_X(T_1\cdot T_2) =(L_XT_1)\cdot T_2+T_1\cdot (L_XT_2), \] where \[ (T_1\cdot T_2)(X_1,\dots ,X_{k_1},Y_1,\dots ,Y_{k_2}) =T_1(X_1,\dots ,X_{k_1})T_2(Y_1,\dots ,Y_{k_2}). \]
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-product-rule

\sketch Evaluate on $(X_1,\dots ,X_{k_1},Y_1,\dots ,Y_{k_2})$. The scalar derivative in subsection 1.2 satisfies the ordinary Leibniz rule, while the slot-correction sum separates into the $X$-slots and the $Y$-slots. These two groups are respectively $(L_XT_1)\cdot T_2$ and $T_1\cdot (L_XT_2)$.
